'''Zhao Jincai''' ({{lang-zh|s=赵进才}}; born December 1960) is a Chinese environmental chemist and researcher of the Institute of Chemistry of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. In April 1994, he obtained a doctorate from Meisei University in Japan.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://lpcas.iccas.ac.cn/english/view_personnel.asp?id=122|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303212508/http://lpcas.iccas.ac.cn/english/view_personnel.asp?id=122|url-status=dead|archive-date=2016-03-03|title=Key Laboratory of Photochemistry, Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences|date=2016-03-03|access-date=2020-03-01}}</ref> In 2011 he was elected as an academician of CAS. He is a professor at the Institute of Chemistry, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences|CAS]]; Deputy Director of Key Laboratory of [[Photochemistry]]; Deputy Director of Science Committee of Molecular Sciences Centre, CAS.<ref name=":1" /> His research mainly focuses on the [[Photocatalysis|photocatalytic degradation]] of toxic and persistent organic pollutants. Zhao introduced {{chem|Ti|O|2}}-based photocatalyst under [[visible light]], and discovered a new way for oxygen atom transfer during photocatalytic reactions.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://yswk.las.ac.cn/qiantai/Shouye_zhanshi.action?id=2011B06#|title=中国科学院院士文库|website=yswk.las.ac.cn|access-date=2020-03-01}}{{Dead link|date=September 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

==Research==
In the early 2000s, Zhao's group reported that visible light can accelerate the degradation of organic pollutants with aqueous
solutions of iron tetrasulfophthalocyanine ([Fe(PcS)]) and [[Hydrogen peroxide|{{chem|H|2|O|2}}]]. They also found out FeBR ([[Ferrous|Fe<sup>2+</sup>]] complex of 2,2′-bipyridine) is efficient in eliminating organic pollutants such as [[rhodamine B]] (RhB), [[malachite green]] (MG) and [[N,N-dimethylaniline|N, N-dimethylaniline]] (DMA). They did several control experiments, in the dark or under irradiation, with or without irradiation. They proposed that when light is introduced, excitation of [Fe<sup>III</sup>(PcS)] can result in [[electron transfer]] from [[ligand]](L) to [[Ferric|Fe<sup>3+</sup>]], then Fe<sup>3+</sup> can be reduced to Fe<sup>2+</sup>. The Fe<sup>2+</sup>-L complex can react with {{chem|H|2|O|2}} to produce HO<sup>.</sup>, leading to the degradation of pollutants.<ref>Tao, X., Ma, W., Zhang, T. and Zhao, J. (2001), Efficient Photooxidative Degradation of Organic Compounds in the Presence of Iron Tetrasulfophthalocyanine under Visible Light Irradiation. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 40: 3014–3016. doi: 10.1002/1521-3773(20010817)40:16<3014::AID-ANIE3014>3.0.CO;2-M.</ref><ref>Ma, W., Li, J., Tao, X., He, J., Xu, Y., Yu, J. C. and Zhao, J. (2003), Efficient Degradation of Organic Pollutants by Using Dioxygen Activated by Resin-Exchanged Iron(II) Bipyridine under Visible Irradiation. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 42: 1029–1032. doi: 10.1002/anie.200390264</ref>

== Contributions ==
Zhao has published over 200 papers in international journals and obtained 20 Chinese invention patents. Zhao won many awards:

2010  Japanese Photochemistry Association Lectureship Award for Asian and OceanianPhotochemist.<ref name=":0"/>

2005  The Second Grade National Prize of Natural Science of China (the first contributor).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://lpcas.iccas.ac.cn/english/view_personnel.asp?id=122|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303212508/http://lpcas.iccas.ac.cn/english/view_personnel.asp?id=122|url-status=dead|archive-date=2016-03-03|title=Key Laboratory of Photochemistry, Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences|date=2016-03-03|access-date=2020-04-07}}</ref>

2002  The Award of Excellent Young Scientists of Chinese Academy of Sciences- Bayer (Germany).<ref name=":0" />

2002  The Fiste Grade Prize of Science and Technology in Beijing (Natural Science).<ref name=":0" />

2002  The Second Grade Prize Military Science and Technique Progress Prize.<ref name=":0" />

1999  Be selected into the first and second levels of "the National Hundred, Thousand and Ten Thousand Talent Project".<ref name=":0" />

1998  The Special Contribution Award from the State Council of China.<ref name=":0" />

1997  Distinguished Young Scientists of NSFC.<ref name=":0" />

1999, 2002, 2006 The Award of Excellent Advisor of Graduates of CAS.<ref name=":0" />
